column1: # TITLE: Transcriptomic study of bronchoalveolar lavage cells in the local environment of non-small cell lung cancer

# SUMMARY: Background: Lung-resident immune cells around local environment of non-small cell lung cancers implicate the balance of pro- and anti-tumor immunity; however the transcriptomic profiles of these cells remain poorly understood. Methods: Transcriptomic microarray study of lung-resident immune cells
column3: was performed in the discovery group and the findings were validated in published microarray datasets and in an independent group by RT-qPCR
